text_en: Last month, the students in Lan's class wanted to make a difference.
They decided to collect books for children in a village school.
The village school had a small library with very few books.
The students made posters and leaflets, and they announced the project at the school meeting.
Many families donated books, and the students sorted them into boxes.
Their target was two hundred books, but they collected over five hundred!
Then they took the books to the village by bus.
The village children were very excited and grateful.
They learned that teamwork can achieve great things.

questions.q: How did the village children feel?
